dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, what happened to your knee?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt ˈhæpənd tə jʊr ˈniː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh, it's embarrassing. I fell over at the supermarket yesterday.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ɪts ɪmˈbærəsɪŋ. aɪ ˈfɛl ˈoʊvər ət ðə ˈsuːpərmɑːrkɪt ˈjɛstərdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Just as I was leaving, I slipped near the door. Someone had just cleaned the floor, and it was still wet.
dialogue.reading: dʒʌst əz aɪ wʌz ˈliːvɪŋ, aɪ ˈslɪpt ˈnɪr ðə ˈdɔːr. ˈsʌmwʌn hæd dʒʌst ˈkliːnd ðə ˈflɔːr, ənd ɪt wʌz ˈstɪl ˈwɛt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh no! Did you drop your shopping?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ! dɪd juː ˈdrɑːp jʊr ˈʃɑːpɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Everything! The moment I hit the floor, my oranges went everywhere.
dialogue.reading: ˈɛvriθɪŋ! ðə ˈmoʊmənt aɪ ˈhɪt ðə ˈflɔːr, maɪ ˈɔːrɪndʒɪz ˈwɛnt ˈɛvriwɛr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, they just stared at me. A little boy laughed out loud.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ðeɪ dʒʌst ˈstɛrd ət miː. ə ˈlɪtəl ˈbɔɪ ˈlæft aʊt ˈlaʊd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Poor you! What did you do?
dialogue.reading: ˈpʊr juː! ˈwʌt dɪd juː ˈduː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: As soon as I stood up, I picked up my bag, and then I tripped over it!
dialogue.reading: əz ˈsuːn əz aɪ ˈstʊd ˈʌp, aɪ ˈpɪkt ˈʌp maɪ ˈbæɡ, ənd ˈðɛn aɪ ˈtrɪpt ˈoʊvər ɪt!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really! This time, the staff came to help me. I'm never going back there!
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli! ðɪs ˈtaɪm, ðə ˈstæf ˈkeɪm tə ˈhɛlp miː. aɪm ˈnɛvər ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈbæk ˈðɛr!
